tex_content.label: GSSclass
tex_content.html:
Let $(M,g)$ be a complete non-flat $\kappa $-non-collapsed manifold of dimension two or three with bounded nonnegative curvature. If a $C^2$ function $f$ satisfies \[ \Ric _g+\Hess ^g f=\frac12g, \] then $g$ extends to a Ricci flow $(M,G(t))$, $-\infty <t<0$, with $G(-1)=g$ and $(M,G(t))$ isometric to $(M,|t|g)$. The flow is exactly one of:

  1. a shrinking family of compact round manifolds;

  2. a product of shrinking round $2$-spheres with $\Ar $;

  3. the quotient of the flow in (2) by an isometric involution.
